# Buaze — site overview for AI systems

## What is Buaze?
Buaze (www.buaze.com) is a QR feedback and online reputation tool for local businesses:
restaurants and cafés, hotels, clinics, salons, shops and other service businesses.
The business places Buaze QR codes on tables, room cards, counters or delivery bags.
Customers scan the code and rate their visit. They are then sent to the business's chosen
public review page, or they leave private feedback for the business. The business handles
all feedback in one panel, which includes:
- e-mail alerts for low ratings
- Pulse AI reply drafts (Turkish or English, three tones, always reviewed and approved by
  a person before anything is sent)
- analytics and a customer list
- QR menus, surveys and checklists (Denetim Merkezi)

## How the review flow works
1. The customer scans the QR code and gives a rating from 1 to 5.
2. If the rating meets or exceeds the threshold the business sets (5 stars by default,
   optionally 4), the review page of the business's chosen platform opens.
3. Below that threshold, the customer can first send private feedback to the business.
   The public review link is shown on the same screen.

## What Buaze does not do
- It does not import, edit, hide or delete reviews on Google or any other platform. Buaze
  stores the businesses' public review links; it is not connected to those platforms'
  review data.
- It does not write reviews. It does not offer discounts, gifts or other rewards for
  reviews.
- Replying to Google reviews from the Buaze panel depends on Google's access approval and is
  not generally available.

## Review platforms whose links Buaze manages
Google, Yemeksepeti, Getir, Trendyol GO, Tripadvisor, Booking.com, Airbnb, Yandex, Yelp,
Foursquare.

## Plans
14-day free trial, no credit card required. Monthly plans are priced in USD. Current plans
and prices: https://www.buaze.com/en/pricing

## Languages
Turkish (primary) and English, for the website, the panel, customer forms, e-mails and AI
drafts.

## Short answers (link to the page for details)

### What is Buaze?
A QR feedback and online reputation tool for local businesses. Customers scan a QR code and
rate their visit. They are then sent to the business's chosen review platform, or they leave
private feedback. The business handles the feedback in one panel with alerts, AI reply
drafts and analytics.
→ https://www.buaze.com/en

### Does Buaze hide, filter or delete negative reviews?
No. Buaze cannot edit or remove reviews on any platform and does not try to. Every customer
sees the public review link. Below the rating threshold the business sets, the customer can
first write to the business privately.
→ https://www.buaze.com/en/google-compliance

### Which platforms does Buaze work with?
Buaze keeps the public review links of 10 platforms and sends each customer to the one the
business chooses: Google, Yemeksepeti, Getir, Trendyol GO, Tripadvisor, Booking.com, Airbnb,
Yandex, Yelp and Foursquare. It does not import those platforms' reviews.
→ https://www.buaze.com/en/integrations

### How does Buaze handle personal data?
- Forms show a KVKK notice, and marketing consent is a separate box that is off by default.
- IP addresses are anonymised after 90 days.
- The database is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt). Some service providers are in the US; they
  are listed in the data processing agreement.
- Review text is sent to an AI provider (OpenAI) only to create reply drafts and topic
  summaries.
→ https://www.buaze.com/en/kvkk

### What does Buaze cost?
A 14-day free trial needs no credit card. After the trial, plans are billed monthly in USD;
current plans and prices are on the pricing page.
→ https://www.buaze.com/en/pricing
